notes: Immediate strict readonly read of the browser-derived axis-aligned rect in top-level viewport CSS pixels, composed through frames including borders/padding. Option.none means no layout box; hidden, transparent and zero-size boxes remain. Reads never wait for a missing match. Target transforms, motion paths and camera clipping follow browser rects, rather than original corner accuracy. Firefox frame rect composition supports positive axis-aligned scaling, CSS zoom and translation; rotation, skew, reflection, 3D, perspective and motion paths on frame ancestors fail with descriptive typed `Unsupported`. Stock defaults are unchanged; no launch profile or preference is required. These documented composition limits belong to the rect contract; immediate reads are a separate design difference.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.

decision.quote: Retrying expectations: a retry has a name and is asked for in code.
